'''Zim Zimley''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] who worked as manager for the band [[Distraction]]. He viewed the band as a way to make money, so was always focused on getting them to play at concerts. He traveled with the band to the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Sleemo Poya Jeedai]]'', where they were scheduled to play and he took on some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] sent by [[Quoltus Firth]] as extra security during the performance, to pay off a favor he owed Firth.
